dashboard.label: ZTA - Zero Trust Architecture Overview
dashboard.description: Real-time monitoring of Envoy access logs, Snort IDS alerts, and nftables firewall activity (indexes: zta_envoy, zta_snort, zta_nftables)

search.query: index=zta_envoy sourcetype="zta:app:query" | timechart span=1m count by decision | sort _time
index=zta_envoy sourcetype="zta:app:query" | stats count by decision

index=zta_envoy sourcetype="zta:app:query" | eval risk_num = tonumber(risk_score) | eval risk_bucket = case( risk_num <= 15, "0-15 (Low)", risk_num <= 30, "16-30 (Medium)", risk_num <= 45, "31-45 (High)", 1=1, "46+ (Critical)" ) | stats count by risk_bucket
index=zta_envoy sourcetype="zta:app:query" | eval risk_num = tonumber(risk_score) | stats avg(risk_num) as avg_risk by user | sort -avg_risk | head 10
index=zta_envoy sourcetype="zta:app:query" decision="DENY" | top limit=10 user | table user count percent

index=zta_envoy sourcetype="zta:app:query" decision="DENY" | eval reason = case( match(user, "urn:device:"), "Certificato Non Registrato", device == "no-tpm" OR hardware_mode == "false" OR hardware_mode == 0, "Dispositivo Non Sotto Controllo (No TPM)", risk_score > 15, "Risk Score Superiore alla Soglia", 1=1, "Violazione Policy Accesso" ) | top limit=10 reason | table reason count percent

index=zta_mongodb (component=COMMAND OR component=ACCESS) | spath | eval ctx = mvindex(context, 0) | eval temp_user = replace(mvindex('attributes.user', 0), "oidc/", "") | sort 0 timestamp | streamstats current=t last(temp_user) as user_by_ctx by ctx | eval final_user = coalesce(user_by_ctx, temp_user) | where component="COMMAND" AND mvindex('attributes.isFromUserConnection', 0)="true" AND isnotnull(final_user) AND final_user != "" AND final_user != "unknown" | eval ns = mvindex('attributes.ns', 0) | eval resource=mvindex(split(ns, "."), 1) | where resource != "$$cmd" AND resource != "admin.$$cmd" AND resource != "config.$$cmd" AND resource != "system" AND resource != "system.views" | rename final_user as user | stats count by user, resource | sort -count | head 50

index=zta_mongodb component="COMMAND" | spath | where mvindex('attributes.isFromUserConnection', 0)="true" | eval ns = mvindex('attributes.ns', 0) | eval resource=mvindex(split(ns, "."), 1) | where resource != "$$cmd" AND resource != "admin.$$cmd" AND resource != "config.$$cmd" AND resource != "system" AND resource != "system.views" | eval command=case( isnotnull(mvindex('attributes.command.find', 0)), "find", isnotnull(mvindex('attributes.command.insert', 0)), "insert", isnotnull(mvindex('attributes.command.update', 0)), "update", isnotnull(mvindex('attributes.command.delete', 0)), "delete", isnotnull(mvindex('attributes.command.aggregate', 0)), "aggregate", isnotnull(mvindex('attributes.command.count', 0)), "count", isnotnull(mvindex('attributes.command.drop', 0)), "drop", 1=1, "unknown" ) | stats count by command | sort -count

index=zta_envoy sourcetype="zta:app:query" | eval device_type = if(device="no-tpm" OR device="unknown" OR hardware_mode="false" OR hardware_mode=0, "No TPM (Software)", "Hardware-Bound") | stats count by device_type decision | table device_type decision count

index=zta_envoy sourcetype="zta:app:query" | eval device = if(device="no-tpm" OR device="unknown", "No TPM (Software)", device) | table _time user resource command decision risk_score device | head 25
index=zta_snort sourcetype="snort:alert_json" | timechart span=5m count by msg
index=zta_snort sourcetype="snort:alert_json" | top limit=10 msg | table msg count percent
index=zta_nftables sourcetype="nftables:log" | timechart span=5m count by action
index=zta_nftables sourcetype="nftables:log" action="DROP" | top limit=10 src_ip | table src_ip count percent

panel.title: Correlazione Snort Alert + OPA Deny (stesso IP)

search.query: index=zta_snort OR index=zta_envoy | eval src=coalesce(src_addr, source_ip) | eval event_type=if(index="zta_snort", "SNORT: ".msg, "OPA: ".decision) | where index="zta_snort" OR decision="DENY" | stats count by src event_type | sort -count | head 20
